description: This file defines the CartFragment class for an Android application. It manages the display and interaction with items in a shopping cart, including loading cart data, updating item quantities, removing items, and navigating to the checkout activity.

classes.name: CartFragment
classes.description: A Fragment subclass that displays shopping cart items, allows quantity updates, removals, and provides navigation to the checkout page.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Inflates the fragment layout, initializes RecyclerView and its adapter, sets up click listeners for checkout, and prepares the view.

methods.name: onResume
methods.description: Reloads cart data when the fragment resumes.

methods.name: loadCart
methods.description: Asynchronously fetches cart items from the repository, updates the adapter, and displays the total price.

methods.name: newInstance
methods.description: Creates a new instance of CartFragment.
